title: The theory works at the cellular level and is neutral on front versus back

statements.text: Dendritic integration theory focuses on the cellular basis of consciousness and takes no side in the debate over whether anterior or posterior cortex holds conscious vision. It is offered as a cellular basis compatible with network theories such as IIT, recurrent processing, neurorepresentationalism and the global workspace.
